描述_EN: when the owners died their pendants were buried with them. small flat slabs of jade carved in the shape of animals or birds were worn as pendants in ancient china. this example takes the shape of a parrot with a high crest and a hooked beak.
描述_ZN: 当主人死后，他们的吊坠被埋葬在一起。 在古代中国，雕刻成动物或鸟类形状的小块扁平玉石被作为吊坠佩戴。 这个例子是一只鹦鹉的形状，有一个高高的徽章和一个钩状的喙。
